{"id":1855276443,"question_id":4158,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 1 week","timestamp":1765706942,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1855276443/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Absolute Difference Between Maximum and Minimum K Elements","memory":"32.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int absDifference(vector<int>& nums, int k) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        sort(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        int temp =k;\n        int sum = 0;\n        while(k--)\n        {\n            sum += nums[n-1];\n            n--;\n        }\n        int i = 0;\n        while(temp--)\n        {\n            sum -= nums[i++];\n        }  \n        return abs(sum);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"absolute-difference-between-maximum-and-minimum-k-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1344}
